# Let me debug the sieve issue
import math
from itertools import compress

def sieve_debug(n):
    data = bytearray((0, 1)) * ((n + 1) // 2)
    print(f"n={n}, data init: {list(data)}, len={len(data)}")
    data[:3] = 0, 0, 0
    print(f"data after [:3]: {list(data)}, len={len(data)}")
    limit = math.isqrt(n) + 1
    print(f"limit: {limit}")
    for p in compress(range(limit), data):
        print(f"p={p}, marking {p*p}:{n}:{p+p}")
        data[p * p : n : p + p] = bytes(len(range(p * p, n, p + p)))
    data[2] = 1
    print(f"data final: {list(data)}")
    return list(data)

print("n=67:")
sieve_debug(67)
print("\nn=30:")
sieve_debug(30)
